issue.title: Record the shared emptied-Pomodoro keymap cleanup decision
issue.description: Proposed by bob-cli-88.1 note 4, bob-cli-88.2 note 1, bob-cli-88.3 note 1, and bob-cli-88.4 note 1. Add the decisions strand link-removal-deletes-emptied-pomodoros, titled Link-Removing Gestures Delete The Pomodoros They Empty, using the accepted contract in plan:202610/emptied_pomodoro_cleanup.md. Eligible gestures delete only entries they empty, judged after all edits; childless means no unfenced list-item child; prose children keep entries; selected-link removal and deferred-only close may delete closed entries; other cleanups remain open-only; whole-block deletion is silent and part of the same write. Cite the plan, final repaired plugin versions, and docs/task-status-hooks.md; read the final bob-cli-88 landing evidence before recording completed behavior. Follow the existing decisions format and run sase memory init. This is a deferred standing policy record, distinct from bob-cli-7q, which proposes changing consumption parity and retaining authored notes.

task_type_fields.proposed_change: Add a standing decision for the accepted bob-cli-88 emptied-entry cleanup contract, after verifying its final landing; update the decisions descriptor through sase memory init.

issue.creation_reason: All four bob-cli-88 phases proposed this skipped memory change after the plan automatically selected decision_record=no without human review. Preserve the proposal for separate review while the implementation landing finishes.
